messages:
Kai (PM): Quick check-in for the Evidence Handshake pilot. Two customers want: BYOK handshake (no escrow), signed export bundles (manifest + per-file sha256), retention lanes up to 7y, and an export SLA we can promise in contract. Target: pilot-ready in ~6w.
Zoe (Eng): We can implement a snapshot+export worker that emits gzipped JSONL parts + manifest. Risks: TB-scale exports will need parallel assembly and will affect SLO; propose pilot SLA = best-effort <4h, gold tier <2h later.
Harper (Security): Requirements: customer key binding to tenant id, replay-resistant export tokens, signed manifest with signer_kid. Default redaction: content_preview redacted; include content_hash. Sampling note: control-plane 100%, content 5% default with opt-in.
Mika (Legal): Need chain-of-custody language and a retention-exception API (legal hold). Also draft a standard export affidavit template. No default key escrow; we'll include an explicit clause.
Ravi (AE): Customers will cover storage costs. Confirm if SOC2 attachments can be included in export bundle. Also ask: any VPC BYOK limitations for pilot?
Zoe (Eng): SOC2 attachments -> include as optional attachments/ folder in manifest. VPC BYOK is heavy (networking + KMS access); for pilot we support customer-signed JWK manifests and HSM signing fallback. VPC-managed KMS is follow-up.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INFR-9012: "Pilot: evidence handshake & signed exports" assigned to Zoe (Eng). ETA 6 weeks.
Kai (PM): Decisions: go pilot with snapshot/export + signed manifest (customer JWK preferred, HSM fallback), retention lanes = 30d/1y/7y, export pilot SLA = best-effort <4h. Action owners: Zoe - proto + cost estimate (2w), Harper - security checklist (1w), Mika - contract addendum + affidavit (4d), Ravi - customer confirmations & pricing (3d). Re-sync next Tue 10am PT. :calendar:
